chunks: He who brings the truth and verifies it, -- such are the people who are God-fearing.
ai.seo_question: Who are the God-fearing people according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as referring to the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) as the bearer of truth and Imam Ali (peace be upon him) as the one who confirmed it, highlighting the inseparable link between prophethood and imamate. It underscores that true piety (taqwa) requires not only internal belief but also the active propagation and validation of divine guidance through the Ahl al-Bayt. This dual role establishes the foundation for spiritual authority and the path to righteousness in Twelver Shi'ism.
